paite: TOUPA aw, hon humbitpa Pathian, sun leh zan in na ma ah ka kikou gige a;
heading: Korah tapate phatna La / Panpih Ngen A Kikouna
english: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Suffering of Affliction.” A contemplation by Heman, the Ezrahite. Yahweh, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.

paite: Ka thumna na ma ah lut henla; ka kikou husa ah na bil hon doh in.
english: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.

paite: Ka hinna mangbatnate in adim a, ka hinna in Sheol anaihta ngal a.
english: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.

paite: Kokhuk a paite toh simkhawm ka hi; hatna himhim neiloumi bang ka hi a;
english: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,

paite: Gal thahte han a lumte bang a misi lak a paihkhiak ka hi; huaite na theih tak louh, na khut a kipan hihman ahi uhi.
english: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.

paite: Kokhuk nuainungpen ah na hon lumsak a, mun mial, thupi ah.
english: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.

paite: Na hehna in hon delhkhum a, nang na tuikihot tengteng in gim na hon thuaksakta hi. Selah
english: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.

paite: Ka meltheihte hon gamlat in na omsak a; amaute a dia kihhuaipi in na hon bawlta a; khakkhum in ka om a, ka pawt thei kei hi.
english: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.

paite: Gimthuak ziak in ka mit aseta a; TOUPA aw, niteng in ka hon sam ahi, nang lam ah ka khutte ka zak hi.
english: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, Yahweh. I have spread out my hands to you.

paite: Misite a ding in thillamdang na hih dek a hia? Sisate'n thou in ahon phat ding ua hia? Selah
english: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.

paite: Na chitdan hankhuk a puangzak in, hiam ahihkeileh na ginomdan Abaddon mun ah puanzak in a-om dia hia?
english: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?

paite: Na thillamdang hihte mial ah theih in a-om dia hia? Na diktatna gam ah theih in a-om dek nawn a hia?
english: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

paite: TOUPA aw, ke'n zaw ka hon sam a, ka thumna in zingsang in ahon don hi.
english: But to you, Yahweh, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.

paite: TOUPA, bang achia ka hinna khahkhia na hia? Bang achia ka lak a na mai sel?
english: Yahweh, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?

paite: Ka naupan chil a kipan gimthuak leh si dekdek in ka om a; na thil mulkimhuaite ka thuak in hihlungbuai in ka om hi.
english: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.

paite: Na heh mahmahna in hon vukmang a; thil mulkimhuaite'n hon hihmangta hi.
english: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.

paite: Huaite'n nitum in tui bang in hon umsuak ua; ka kim ka vel in hon um chiat uhi.
english: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.

paite: Hon itpa leh ka lawm hon gamlat in a-omsakta a, ka meltheihnate mial ah na omsakta ahi.
english: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.
